response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of broad full-stack experience and is currently working directly on AI-agent infrastructure, MCP tooling, and agentic workflows at a Staff Software Engineer title, which aligns well with the AI-native mindset the role demands. However, the resume shows no mention of Python at all (a stated must-have), his current Staff-level title is only ~4 months old following a long run of Senior titles, and there is limited recent evidence of high-throughput distributed systems work or explicit stakeholder/on-call/agile ownership at the scale this role requires.
strengths: Hands-on current experience building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic developer tooling
Deep, wide-ranging technical breadth across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems built over 15+ years
Demonstrated ownership mindset via founding/maintaining an open-source geo-data platform and running workshops/talks
concerns: No Python listed anywhere in skills or experience despite it being a core must-have requirement
Staff-level title is very recent (~4 months) with no track record yet of technical strategy or cross-functional influence at that level
Limited recent or explicit evidence of on-call/incident ownership, stakeholder management, or agile/scrum ceremony experience

key_factors.factor: Thin, dated evidence of high-throughput distributed systems and staff-level scope
